## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 451 captures during April 2025. Activity proceeded as planned overall, with session lists maintained through the reporting period. The only operational exception noted was routine leave. There were no reported interruptions to the scheduled activity beyond this usual staffing arrangement.

The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below. The figures reflect the captures completed at the site during the month and the subsequent review of those images.

## Image quality

Of the 451 captures, 91 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 20.2%. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome.

The result indicates that image quality remained an important operational consideration during the month. The ungradable captures should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service and planning any local follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 89 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that, for the midpoint of completed grading activity, the interval from image capture to the grading outcome was 1 day.
